# Extraction { #timetoalign.Extraction }

```python
Extraction(
    id,
    source=None,
    source_integrity=None,
    parser,
    parser_version,
    parameters=None,
    minter=ID_MINTER,
    id_length=ID_LENGTH,
    seed=None,
    date=_now(),
)
```

One run of a parser over one source file: what made a set of events.

A row of the Extraction table (CRMdig's D10 Software Execution): the
source file and its digest, the parser and its version, the parameters
it ran with, and the ID minter's algorithm, length and seed, so that a
run again over the same file mints the same IDs. Events made without a
source file (in code, by a script) name the tool's extraction
(:meth:`of_tool`). Extractions sharing an ID hash alike.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name             | Type                                                                              | Description                                                                                       |
|------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| id               | [str](`str`)                                                                      | The extraction's ID (``extraction_…``).                                                           |
| source           | [str](`str`) \| None                                                              | The source file, a path or URI reference; None for events made without one.                       |
| source_integrity | [Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [str](`str`)\] \| None        | ``{"algorithm": "SHA-256", "digest": <hex>}`` of the source file; None exactly where *source* is. |
| parser           | [str](`str`)                                                                      | The parser's name.                                                                                |
| parser_version   | [str](`str`)                                                                      | Its version.                                                                                      |
| parameters       | [Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] \| None | The parameters it ran with, or None.                                                              |
| minter           | [str](`str`)                                                                      | The algorithm of the ID minter (:data:`~timetoalign.core.ids.ID_MINTER`).                         |
| id_length        | [int](`int`)                                                                      | The length of the minted IDs' suffixes.                                                           |
| seed             | [str](`str`) \| None                                                              | The seed given to the minter, if one was, as text.                                                |
| date             | [str](`str`)                                                                      | When it ran, ISO 8601 in UTC (``2026-11-27T21:30:00Z``).                                          |

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                         |
|--------|----------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If *source* and *source_integrity* are not both given or both None. |

### of_source { #timetoalign.Extraction.of_source }

```python
Extraction.of_source(
    path,
    *,
    source=None,
    parser,
    parser_version,
    parameters=None,
    minter=ID_MINTER,
    id_length=ID_LENGTH,
    seed=None,
    id=None,
    date=None,
)
```

The extraction of a parser's run over the file *path*.

The file's SHA-256 digest is read from its bytes. The ID, when
minted, is seeded from the digest, the parser and its version, the
parameters, the minter's algorithm and length and the seed, never
from where the file lies: a run over the same bytes with the same
parser and parameters has the same ID on every machine, in every
run and every process.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                                                                                                     | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | Default     |
|----------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------|
| path           | [str](`str`) \| [PathLike](`os.PathLike`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| [zipfile](`zipfile`).[Path](`zipfile.Path`) | The source file, read here: a path, or a member of a ZIP archive read in place (a ``zipfile.Path`` of an archive opened from its path).                                                                                                                            | _required_  |
| source         | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                                     | The reference recorded for it (a path relative to a package's root, a URI); when None, *path* as given (POSIX separators), a member's ``jar:`` URI (``jar:file:///data/set.zip!/notes/1.csv``, the archive's absolute path and the member's path percent-encoded). | `None`      |
| parser         | [str](`str`)                                                                                             | The parser's name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | _required_  |
| parser_version | [str](`str`)                                                                                             | Its version.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | _required_  |
| parameters     | [Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] \| None                        | The parameters it ran with.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `None`      |
| minter         | [str](`str`)                                                                                             | The algorithm of the ID minter.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `ID_MINTER` |
| id_length      | [int](`int`)                                                                                             | The length of the IDs it minted.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `ID_LENGTH` |
| seed           | [int](`int`) \| [str](`str`) \| None                                                                     | The seed given to the minter, if one was.                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `None`      |
| id             | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                                     | The extraction's ID; minted when None.                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | `None`      |
| date           | [str](`str`) \| None                                                                                     | When it ran; now when None.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `None`      |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                        |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [OSError](`OSError`)       | If the file cannot be read.                                                                        |
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | If *path* is a member of an archive opened from a file object and *source* is None: it has no URI. |

### of_tool { #timetoalign.Extraction.of_tool }

```python
Extraction.of_tool(
    parser='timetoalign',
    parser_version=None,
    *,
    scope=None,
    id=None,
    date=None,
)
```

The extraction of events made without a source file.

A registry makes one of its own (for its root timeline) when events
made in code join it.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type                 | Description                                                                                                      | Default         |
|----------------|----------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------|
| parser         | [str](`str`)         | The tool's name; ``"timetoalign"`` by default.                                                                   | `'timetoalign'` |
| parser_version | [str](`str`) \| None | Its version; this library's by default.                                                                          | `None`          |
| scope          | [str](`str`) \| None | What the extraction is one of (a root timeline's ID); a minted ID is seeded from it, the parser and its version. | `None`          |
| id             | [str](`str`) \| None | The extraction's ID; minted when None.                                                                           | `None`          |
| date           | [str](`str`) \| None | When it ran; now when None.                                                                                      | `None`          |

### to_row { #timetoalign.Extraction.to_row }

```python
Extraction.to_row()
```

The extraction as a row of the Extraction table.

``parameters`` is canonical JSON text (sorted keys, no spaces).
